data.name: Karraar
data.gender_notes: Karraar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'karrar', meaning 'to be firm or steadfast'. This name carries a deep spiritual significance, representing a person who is unwavering in their faith and convictions. It is a name of great honor and respect in Islamic tradition. The name Karraar carries the meaning “Firm, strong, steadfast” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Karraar usually hope their child will grow to embody firm, strong, steadfast and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of unwavering faith and resilience.
data.etymology: Karraar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Firm, strong, steadfast.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Karraar total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
